name: rsa-challenge
description: An interactive RSA challenge website rewritten with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). Each challenge presents a real RSA modulus from the historical RSA Factoring Challenge, along with a ciphertext. Your goal is to recover the original plaintext. Guesses are verified using SHA‑256 and recorded on the leaderboard.

paragraphs: An interactive RSA challenge website rewritten with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). features: Challenge selection: Choose RSA‑100, RSA‑110, … from dropdown
Guess verification: SHA‑256 check against stored hash
Leaderboard: Displays top solvers, latest solve, per‑challenge counts
Persistence: MongoDB stores solves with nickname, challenge, timestamp
Duplicate protection: Prevents duplicate submissions for same nickname/challenge
